messages.subject: Graph obfuscate on Shine auto-refresh
parts:
Hi, I have a doubt about "auto-refresh" on shiny: I'm using reactivePoll(2000, ... and plotting a ggplot line graph, my problem is, every time that occurs a refresh, the graph obfuscate ( I´m not sure if its clear, I can try record a video).

On every refresh, a new query on SQLServer is made, and takes 1 seconds, is this period when graph is obfuscate. The code below (on gitHub too), connect on SQLServer and simulate a query thats take 1s.

Is there any way to graph not obfuscate on refresh? Query SQLserver on background process?



Windows Server 2012
R-3.2.0
Package shiny version 0.12.0

codes:
https://github.com/faustobranco/shinyquestions/tree/master/dash01




ui.R:

library(shiny)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Entrada Bytes/Segundo"),

    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("distPlot")
    )
))



server.R:

library(shiny)
library("RODBC")            
library("ggplot2")            

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  cargaDados <- function() {
    
    #df_ENTRADA <- sqlQuery(odbcChannel, "Select NO_DTENTRADA, TAM_ENTRADA, TEMPO from [dbo].[TRACKING_BI_ENTRADA] Where NO_DTENTRADA >= dateadd(day, -10, getdate())")    

    df_ENTRADA <- sqlQuery(odbcChannel, "SELECT DATEADD(day , number - 1 , DateAdd(dd, 0, DateDiff(dd,0,GetDate()))) [Category], cast(999 * RAND(CAST( NEWID() AS varbinary ))  as int) as [x] FROM master..spt_values WHERE type = 'P' AND number < 10;  WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:01';")    
    
    
    #df_ENTRADA <- cbind(df_ENTRADA, as.integer(df_ENTRADA$TAM_ENTRADA / df_ENTRADA$TEMPO), na.rm=TRUE)
    #colnames(df_ENTRADA)[4] <- "TamanhoSegundo"
    
    #df_ArquivosData <- aggregate(x = df_ENTRADA$TamanhoSegundo, by=list(Category=df_ENTRADA$NO_DTENTRADA), FUN=mean, na.rm=TRUE)
    
    #df_ArquivosData[,2] <- sample(1:10)
    
    ggplot(data=df_ENTRADA, aes(x=Category, colour=Category)) + geom_line(aes(y=x, color = "Bytes/Segundo"))
    
    
  }
  
  
  
  odbcChannel <- odbcConnect("SQLBIMDI", believeNRows=FALSE)   
  
  autoInvalidate <- reactivePoll(2000, session, checkFunc = function() { Sys.time() }, cargaDados)                 #Força o refresh a cada 2s
  
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    
    print(autoInvalidate())
    
    
  })
  
  
})
